name: – Mohammed Chahim – Commission proposal
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2023/956 as regards the extension of its scope to downstream goods and anti-circumvention measures
part_text:
The report sets out Parliament's position on widening the carbon border levy (a charge on imports of high-carbon goods) to cover more finished products made from steel and aluminium, and on closing loopholes. It adds many product codes to the covered list, tightens rules against companies dodging the charge, and adds support and reporting duties for poorer trading partners. It also removes the Commission's proposed power to drop goods from the list in emergencies.

- **What changes:** more steel and aluminium products face the levy; new anti-dodging rules; scrap rules adjusted.
- **Who it affects:** EU importers, foreign producers, online sellers, and trading partners in poorer countries.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's position goes to talks with EU governments before any law is final.
